title: How Mike Shannon DDS Reduced Pediatric Dental No-Shows with PracticeDilly
description: For any pediatric dental practice, appointment no-shows impact revenue and patient care. See how Mike Shannon DDS transformed scheduling, reduced no-show rates, and reclaimed hours of staff time using PracticeDilly's automated reminders and scheduling software.
content:
For any pediatric dental practice, appointment no-shows are more than just a scheduling inconvenience. They directly impact revenue, staff productivity, and patient care continuity. For Mike Shannon DDS, reducing no-show appointments became a top operational priority — and the solution came through automation with PracticeDilly.

This case study explores how Mike Shannon's pediatric dental office transformed its scheduling workflow, reduced appointment no-show rates, and reclaimed hours of staff time using automated appointment reminders and scheduling software from PracticeDilly.

## Life Before PracticeDilly: Manual Scheduling Bottlenecks

Before implementing PracticeDilly, Mike Shannon DDS relied heavily on manual processes to manage appointments and confirmations.

Front office staff would:

- Send individual email reminders to every patient
- Make confirmation phone calls daily
- Log each confirmation manually into the practice management system
- Track scheduling updates by hand

The result? An overwhelming administrative burden.

### Key Challenges Faced

High Number of Unresponsive Patients: Many reminder emails went unanswered. Phone calls frequently went to voicemail. This led to uncertainty about which appointments were confirmed and which were at risk of becoming no-shows.

Manual Input Errors: Because confirmations were logged manually, occasional data entry mistakes caused scheduling confusion. Double bookings and missed updates became frustrating pain points.

Excessive Administrative Time:

- 30–45 minutes per day spent making confirmation calls
- 2–3 hours per day sending reminder emails
- Nearly half the workday consumed by appointment management

In a pediatric dental practice — where patient volume can be high and appointment turnover rapid — this inefficiency created unnecessary operational strain. Most importantly, the practice continued to experience preventable appointment no-shows.

## The Turning Point: Implementing PracticeDilly

Recognizing the need for a more efficient system, Mike Shannon DDS implemented PracticeDilly's automated appointment reminder and scheduling platform.

PracticeDilly specializes in helping dental and healthcare practices reduce no-shows, improve patient communication, and streamline front desk workflows through automation. The software is designed to:

- Automate appointment confirmations via email and SMS
- Allow one-click confirmations from patients
- Sync directly with practice scheduling systems
- Track confirmation rates in real time
- Reduce manual scheduling tasks

For Mike Shannon's office, the impact was immediate.

## Life After PracticeDilly: Automation That Works

Once PracticeDilly was integrated into the practice's workflow, the administrative burden dropped dramatically.

### Simple One-Click Confirmations

Patients could now confirm appointments by clicking a button in an email or replying to a text message. This frictionless process significantly improved response rates. For busy parents — the core patient demographic of a pediatric dental practice — quick SMS confirmations proved especially effective.

### Real-Time Sync with Scheduling System

Because PracticeDilly synced with the practice's schedule, confirmations were automatically logged. There was no longer a need for manual input. This eliminated human error and reduced scheduling confusion.

### Fully Automated Reminder Sequences

Instead of manually sending emails or making calls, reminder sequences were automated. Practices can configure reminder timing — such as 48 hours and 24 hours before appointments — ensuring patients receive timely prompts without staff intervention.

### Major Time Savings

The most immediate operational win? Time. By eliminating 2–3 hours of daily email work and reducing phone confirmations, the front office regained several productive hours each day. That time could now be redirected toward:

- Improving patient experience
- Handling billing and insurance coordination
- Assisting walk-in patients
- Supporting clinical staff

## Measurable Outcomes

After implementing PracticeDilly, Mike Shannon DDS saw clear improvements across multiple areas.

### Decreased No-Show Appointments

Automated reminders and simplified confirmations significantly reduced appointment no-show rates. Higher confirmation visibility allowed staff to proactively fill open slots when necessary.

### Increased Patient Engagement

Because confirmations were easier and more convenient, response rates improved dramatically. Patients appreciated the modern communication approach.

### Elimination of Manual Errors

With automated logging and syncing, the risk of data entry mistakes dropped to nearly zero.

### Improved Staff Productivity

By removing repetitive administrative tasks, the office operated more efficiently and effectively. Front desk staff experienced less stress and more structured workflows.

## Final Thoughts: A Smarter Way to Run a Pediatric Dental Practice

Reducing appointment no-shows isn't just about sending more reminders. It's about making confirmations effortless and eliminating manual inefficiencies.

For Mike Shannon DDS, PracticeDilly delivered: lower no-show rates; automated scheduling workflows; better patient communication; significant daily time savings; and a more efficient front office.

In today's competitive dental environment, practices that leverage automated appointment reminder software gain a measurable operational advantage. PracticeDilly shows how the right technology can turn administrative bottlenecks into operational momentum.

title: Pacific Ocean Dental Group Improved Google Rating from 2.5 to 4.6 Stars in Just 6 Months
description: Dr. Hyun Sook Lim's Los Angeles practice had a 2.5-star Google rating despite strong patient loyalty. See how PracticeDilly's reputation management helped them reach 4.6 stars in six months.
content:
In today's digital-first healthcare environment, online reviews can make or break a dental practice. For patients searching "best dentist in Los Angeles" or "top-rated dental clinic near me," Google ratings are often the deciding factor. Studies consistently show that: 84% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations; 90% of patients read online reviews before choosing a dental practice.

For Pacific Ocean Dental Group in Los Angeles, online reputation became a serious growth barrier when their Google rating dropped to 2.5 stars—well below the national dental industry average of around 4 stars. Here's how PracticeDilly helped transform their online reputation, increasing their Google rating to 4.6 stars in just six months.

## Background: A Highly Skilled Dentist with an Underrated Online Presence

Dr. Hyun Sook Lim is not your average practitioner. She holds a Master's Degree in Periodontology, along with advanced training in cosmetic veneers and dental implants. Her commitment to continuing education ensures she stays current with modern dental techniques. Patients who visit her clinic often remain loyal for years. She has built strong personal relationships and provides compassionate, high-quality care. Yet despite her clinical excellence and patient loyalty, her Google profile told a different story.

At the time, Pacific Ocean Dental Group had an average Google rating of just 2.5 stars. Several 1-star reviews appeared without clear explanations. Some may not have even been from patients. Dr. Lim attempted to work with Google to remove questionable reviews. Unfortunately, like many business owners discover, review removal is extremely difficult unless policy violations are proven. The negative rating was discouraging—and potentially driving away new patients.

## The Challenge: Repairing Online Reputation Without Removing Reviews

Dr. Lim faced three key challenges:

### Low Google Star Rating

With a 2.5-star rating, the practice appeared significantly below competitors in Los Angeles.

### Anonymous 1-Star Reviews

Several negative reviews lacked context. Dr. Lim suspected some may have been left by non-patients or former employees.

### New Patient Acquisition Risk

In competitive markets like Los Angeles, prospective patients often choose practices with 4+ star ratings. A low rating can drastically reduce phone calls and website conversions. Dr. Lim needed a solution that would: increase positive Google reviews; improve average star rating; strengthen Yelp and Facebook profiles; rebuild trust with prospective patients.

## The Strategy: Focus on Happy Patients, Not Negative Reviews

Dr. Lim discovered PracticeDilly through a marketing agency referral. PracticeDilly offers a dental online reputation management solution designed specifically for healthcare practices. Instead of trying to fight or remove existing negative reviews, the strategy focuses on: consistently generating authentic reviews from satisfied patients. This approach works because the Google algorithm favors recency and volume. By steadily increasing 5-star reviews, the overall rating improves naturally.

## How PracticeDilly Works

PracticeDilly integrates seamlessly into dental practice workflows and provides tools such as:

### Automated Review Requests via Text Message

After an appointment, patients receive a text with a direct review link. With one tap, they are taken to the practice's Google, Yelp, or Facebook page.

### Front Office-Friendly System

Staff can easily trigger review requests from the dashboard or mobile app without adding administrative burden.

### Multi-Platform Reputation Management

Reviews can be directed to: Google Business Profile; Yelp; Facebook.

### Automated Patient Communication

Beyond reviews, PracticeDilly also supports: appointment reminders; two-way texting; patient confirmations. This creates more satisfied patients—which naturally leads to more positive reviews.

## The Results: 2.5 to 4.6 Stars in 6 Months

Within six months of implementing PracticeDilly: Google rating improved from 2.5 stars to 4.6 stars; dozens of new 5-star reviews were added; Yelp and Facebook profiles gained positive traction; online reputation was fully transformed. The improvement wasn't just cosmetic—it impacted real growth.

### Increased New Patient Flow

With a higher rating and stronger online presence, Pacific Ocean Dental Group began seeing: more website visits; higher conversion rates; increased new patient appointments. Today, Dr. Lim is no longer concerned about the older negative reviews. The overwhelming volume of recent positive feedback outweighs them.

## Final Takeaway

Pacific Ocean Dental Group's transformation proves a powerful principle: You don't need to remove bad reviews to fix your reputation. You need a system to consistently generate good ones. With PracticeDilly's automated review requests and patient communication tools, Dr. Lim: increased her Google rating from 2.5 to 4.6; strengthened her presence on Yelp and Facebook; boosted new patient growth; regained confidence in her online reputation.

title: How Dr. Mudita Agarwal Thrived During the Pandemic with PracticeDilly

content:
